goal: Defend STMT-MAXIME-ENS-IS-GOD, the open premise that the quarta via's maximal being is the God of ST I q.105 a.5 (who applies every created agent to act). It replaces the #166 first-being bridge on the root path (#147). The quarta via's 'et hoc dicimus Deum' supports it only nominally (relation REL-AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-QUARTA-VIA-DICIMUS-DEUM-SUPPORTS-MAXIME-ENS-IS-GOD). Places to look: q.105 a.5's own description of God as 'the First and Universal Cause' and 'properly the cause of universal being', read against q.44 a.1 (every being is from God) and q.8 a.1 (God is in all things as cause of their being); a uniqueness argument for the maximum in being would also serve.
reason: Open premise of AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-FIRST-MOVER-IS-MAXIME-ENS and its dependents; withoutMaximeEnsIsGodNotFirstBeing verifies that it is needed.
